novels.title: He Came From the Fire
novels.excerpt: When sixteen-year-old Nanchu's home catches fire, she is trapped in her room and sees a firefighter coming through the flames to rescue her. Five years later, they reunite - she's now a star, and he's still fighting fires. A beautiful story of love, courage, and second chances.
novels.description:
When sixteen-year-old Nanchu's home catches fire, she is trapped in her room and, in a daze, sees a man dressed in a uniform coming through the flames to rescue her.

Five years later, Nanchu has become a famous actress, while Lin Luchu continues his work as a firefighter, fighting on the front lines of disaster areas. When they reunite, old feelings resurface, but both have changed.

A captivating romance story that explores themes of love, courage, and personal growth. This beautifully written tale celebrates the selflessness of firefighters while telling a moving love story that will touch your heart.
